request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere: book covers are plain, screens show only soft abstract color. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep every person, animal and object of the action inside the central 60 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

These are members of one ordinary family, new to the course: they are not famous people and do not look like any earlier course character.

Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background. The person does not look at the camera.

The daughter's small bedroom at night: the daughter (about 15, long dark hair in a ponytail, a red hoodie) sits at a white desk under a warm desk lamp and studies, writing in an open notebook with a pencil, a stack of plain school books beside her. The window behind the desk shows a dark night sky; the room is lit only by the lamp. Her face is in three-quarter view, looking down at the notebook.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
